roles.title: Finance & Accounting Intern
requirements: Commerce, Finance, or Accounting students (or recent graduates)
Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
Understanding of accounts and financial statements
Curious, detail-oriented, and ready to learn
responsibilities: Maintain clean and accurate financial books
Prepare performa accounting and financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)
Assist with budgeting, expense tracking, and invoice checks
Support fundraising preparations (real exposure to startup fundraising)
Coordinate with CA firm on audits and compliance
